heading: Family child care providers

tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: Not less frequently than quarterly, the Commandant shall ensure that each family child care provider is subject to inspection.

tree.heading: Responsibility for Inspections.—
tree.text: Of the quarterly inspections under subsection (a) each year—

children.text: 3 inspections shall be carried out by a representative of the Coast Guard installation served by the family child care provider concerned; and
1 inspection shall be carried out by a representative of the Coast Guard child development services work-life programs.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 116–283, div. G, title LVXXXII [LXXXII], § 8237(b)(1), Jan. 1, 2021, 134 Stat. 4665.)
